bio: Even after more than 25 years since its opening, Vinaiolo continues to bring a delightful taste of la dolce vita to Haidhausen. Attentive service comes courtesy of a charming, well-drilled team, embodying a spirit that is tipicamente italiano. Although the Italian cuisine served here is not focused on any particular region, it is unfailingly authentic. Mouthwatering options such as the Sardinian fregola with lamb ragout and the Nebrodi pork chop are testament to this. Excellent selection of Italian wines. The cosy, authentic atmosphere is accentuated by furnishings salvaged from a Trieste grocer's shop dating back to 1904!...
